acceptance: Behavior: reproduce the intended action, refusal and no-op cases; preserve unrelated widget hierarchy, bindings, styles and event flows.
Output: clear grammatical English, exact asset/node identities, complete actionable context, explicit unknown or omitted data; never imply compile, save or verification happened when it did not.
Discovery/help: concise role, required parameters, valid values, examples, prerequisites, side effects, limitations and next steps understandable without undocumented assumptions.
Code/helpers: review implementation and shared helpers, validation, mutation boundaries, error propagation and comments documenting actual behavior.
Visual/runtime: inspect widget states and graph layout; static preview alone cannot prove interaction.
Evidence: record each tool used, actual output, scenario result, remaining gaps and user visual feedback; no blanket bug-free claim.
